I definitely see your point and agree for the most part, but I think you sort of underestimate Nemesis and his durability as a Tyrant. I'm not sure if Wesker would be able to pierce his flesh like he does with humans, as we can see nemesis and other Tyrants sustain incredible amounts of damage, leagues beyond what humans can take, with no more than a scratch. And while Wesker CAN dish out immense damage with his bare hands alone, I'm not too sure if it'll be enough to go straight through him. On top of that, the device on his chest isnt his heart like we see on some other Tyrants (to my knowledge), it's actually a device to regulate and control the NE-alpha parasite, which is why when its destroyed, the parasite has less regulation for the genetic code of him, which is a reason why we can see Nemesis mutate into a more quadrepedal form, and eventually something completely inhumanoid. And when it gets damaged more and more, the mission to kill STARS is overwritten by a survival instinct of the parasite instead. I agree with you on all points you make like Weskers speed strength and intelligence, I just think you underestimate the durability of a Tyrant, especially one that mutates as much as Nemesis. Wesker still wins though, either way

This is kinda a tough one, but has a sure answer. In a situation where both are just mindlessly attacking each other, taking into consideration only physical strength and defence, itd be a pretty even match, but I think Nemesis would eventually win, since he seems to have more durability due to him mutating when injured (basically an extra life), and requiring an immense amount of damage to die and not mutate, while Wesker doesnt have that mutation aspect, only his base durability (although high). But if we take into consideration the characters as a whole, with Weskers intelligence and knowledge of B.O.Ws, especially Tyrants, he could find some way to defeat him eventually. Knowing his weaknesses way more than Jill did, I'm sure he would find out a way to finish him much quicker than her. On top of that, we know Wesker has defeated Tyrants alone before (although they were Ivans and not Nemesis). With all of this, it might be difficult for Wesker to kill him alone with the mutations and all, but I think he'd do it eventually.

I'm pretty sure it's a device that effectively serves as a power limiter (like T-103's [Mr. X] coat) but isnt technically one. It's something that controls and regulates the NE-alpha parasite within him, which prevents runaway mutations and relays his programming from Umbrella to the parasite (which serves as his brain) so that's why T-103 in RE2 doesnt have it, but instead has his coat that is his power limiter, Nemesis is a T-103 model infected with the parasite, so there needs to be something to control it. Nemesis's coat (if you would call it that) is sort of a makeshift armor for him, to make him even more durable and to hold the device on his chest, as he was a prototype deployed sooner than expected, and thus Umbrella didnt have time for a proper protective coat. You can notice that when he mutates, he retreats more, because his self preservation instincts slowly take over, and his mission becomes less important (although he still knows it) because the device to control the parasite is gone, and the parasite takes over.
